question: 56 tube lights were purchased for ₹56, and 20 tube lights broke in transit. The trader sold the remaining tube lights at ₹4.60 each. Find his profit.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Cost Price (CP) for 56 tube lights = ₹56

Number of sellable tube lights = 56 − 20 = 36

Total Selling Price (SP) = 36 × 4.60 = ₹165.60

Profit = Total SP − Total CP = 165.60 − 56 = ₹109.60

**∴ The correct answer is ₹109.60.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total tube lights purchased = 56

Total Cost Price (CP) = ₹56

Number of broken tube lights in transit = 20

Selling Price (SP) per remaining tube light = ₹4.60

**Formula Used:**

Profit = Total Selling Price − Total Cost Price
